description: Create a Recovery server instance for a Cloud DB for MySQL instance. Restores from backup file or point-in-time.

cloudMysqlRecoveryServerName.description: Recovery server name prefix (3-20 chars, starts with letter, ends with letter/number, allows '-')

fileName.description: Backup file name for restore (getCloudMysqlBackupDetailList). If specified, recoveryTime is ignored. One of fileName or recoveryTime is required.

recoveryTime.description: Point-in-time recovery (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm). If specified, fileName is ignored. One of fileName or recoveryTime is required.

subnetNo.description: Subnet number for Recovery server. Required when isMultiZone=true. Ignored when isMultiZone=false.

name: ncloud_create_mysql_recovery
